summary: Update content property for custom content by id
description:
Update a content property for a piece of custom content by its id. 

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to edit the custom content.

parameters.name: custom-content-id
parameters.description: The ID of the custom content the property belongs to.

parameters.name: property-id
parameters.description: The ID of the property to be updated.

requestBody.description: The content property to be updated.

200.description: Returned if the content property was updated successfully.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if the calling user does not have permission to view the
specified custom content or the custom content was not found.
